name: 楊重光
objective: This course will present the techniques and their corresponding theories on the surface property measurements including chemical information, stress analysis, morphology, crystalline structure and intermolecular forces between interfaces. The course also includes a practical training on the FTIR microscope, atomic force microscope, reology meter on the semiconductor materials.
課程進度(1-16週):
1-3 :  X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis and its theory fundamentals
4-6 :  Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) analysis and its theory fundamentals
7-9 : Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) analysis and its theory fundamentals
10-11 : Raman spectroscopy analysis and its theory fundamentals
12-13 :  Fourier-Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) analysis and its theory fundamentals
14-16 : Theory and the applications of x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS)
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Students will use AI-assisted tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or other discipline-specific AI platforms) to support literature review, data analysis, problem solving, and theory practice. Students will learn how to use their learning in the classroom and critically evaluate AI-generated results, verify information with reliable scientific evidences, and appropriately cite AI-assisted work in accordance with academic integrity guidelines.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          5
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Through these activities, students will develop AI literacy, critical thinking, research skills, and the ability to apply AI responsibly in engineering and scientific practice.

This training together with the classroom lectures is appropriate for graduate courses in engineering, materials science, chemical engineering, semiconductor technology, and related fields.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Students’ learning achievements will be evaluated through the submission of an AI-assisted project report. Students are expected to demonstrate their ability to apply AI tools appropriately, critically evaluate AI-generated outputs, integrate reliable scientific evidence, and communicate their findings effectively. Assessment will be based on the quality of the final additional report, technical accuracy, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
